verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for an authentication product, since comparable authenticator and MFA products can expose developer SDKs. Nothing in the pack documents an official SDK for building against Microsoft Authenticator: the docs cover only end-user features such as sign-in, backup, passkeys and Verified IDs. The probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, so there is no evidence of any developer-facing surface either.
